1937, July
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 202 July 21 Mrs. Wm. Walker - 59 - came to monastery June 3, her husband a convert, had wandered away and fallen from religion altogether. That was ten years ago and folks had received no word from him during all that time. He had changed his name. June 3rd last which was Thursday his wife came and had the Poor Souls Enrolled in the S. Mass Assoc'n for that intention .... The following Monday June 7th she received a telephone message about her husband who had died May 25 seven yrs. ago. This message came to his wife while his own mother ... still methodist ... was present. Next day the messenger came and told everything ..... (Goss messenger) Mr. Walker (Parker) had turned back to Church and was plan- ing to get back to Detroit & family when + suddenly-heart .... Remorse of Conscious forced messenger to give secret ....
Thomas Thayre - 21 - was struck by an Auto when only 7 and has had operations ever since; now fearfully Epileptic
Billie Zerge - 7 - new Jaw-bone ! ! !
Baby Rob. Anthony Repson -LeSall, Il1. - 10 mo. - can now eat ....
Page 203 July 22 Violet Whitman - 41 - cronic kidney tro'le E'd DeWitt - 45 - financial .... has 9 children .... needs help.
Joseph Clyde Prine - 10 - had spinal manengitis - has never regained hearing otherwise bright and amiable.
27 Mary E. Grady - 58 - Gall-stone trouble had double goitre removed 7 yrs ago & was prayed for. Dr's considered it "test case". . Thanks to prayers they were surprised. Now asks for prayers that the Lord direct operation.
Mrs. Wm. Buhrow - 45 - Lakeside, Ohio - Lutheran, doctoring for 8 yrs ... kink in intestines - nothing has helped ...... has 3 little-
Lanyo Decker - 32 - tuomer on brain - para .. . Episcopilian - Rom- ulus, Mich.
Mrs. James Elliott - 62 - arteries- Vericose veins. . .hurt Mary Henn - 60 - cancer of spine "Won't get better .
Mary Haming - 38 - cancer - has four children
Irene Zalewski - 27 - Eye .....
